reply.text:
Congratulations, that's a big six weeks. When you're cleared to run again is a call for your doctor or a pelvic floor physio, not me. It depends on how your delivery and recovery went, and they are the ones who can check you at your postnatal visit.

Once they give you the go-ahead, I'll happily build the return around it, starting easy and working up gradually. Tell me what they clear you for, and I can also line up some gentle strength and walking work in the meantime if you want it.
